The whole team was incredibly friendly and helpful, they happily accommodated our food requests (fresh coconut!), and the chef showed us lots of plants and herbs on tuk-tuk tours. A small batik workshop in Habaraduwa (behind the airfield) is also highly recommended – they have beautiful pieces. Ayurvedic massages can be arranged at the hotel upon request – highly recommended! Galle is also definitely worth a (tuk-tuk) trip. And on our last evening, a 1-meter-long turtle came ashore right next to the hotel to lay its eggs. All in all, a truly relaxing and varied holiday with excellent value for money – highly recommended!
